Thanks for flagging. A few items we need to lock down before I can support above-band movement:
1) Band justification: please share the role leveling doc and why Damien is an L5 vs L6 (if we treat as stretch). What specific scope/ownership maps to the larger base?
2) Budget code: confirm cost center (eng-platform hiring pool Q4). If this is > band top, we'll need to consume a hiring premium bucket which Finance must confirm.
